{{Top|leg}}
The '''charter of the Alliance''' was the constitution of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It notably gave [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma]]&mdash;and, by her authority, the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]&mdash;near-[[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorial]] power over all [[Allied Command]]s and their military forces.<ref name="RAS, 2nd">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
